description: This file defines the PoHeader class for handling Gettext PO headers within Drupal, including parsing, generating, and evaluating plural forms.

classes.name: PoHeader
classes.description: A class for managing Gettext PO file headers, including parsing header strings, generating header output, and evaluating plural forms.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a PoHeader object with default values, setting language code, creation date, and default plural forms.

methods.name: getPluralForms
methods.description: Returns the plural form string from the header.

methods.name: setFromString
methods.description: Populates header properties from a header string.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Generates a formatted header string based on current object properties.

methods.name: parsePluralForms
methods.description: Parses the 'Plural-Forms' header value to extract number of plurals and plural formula, evaluating the formula for different values.

methods.name: parseHeader
methods.description: Parses a header string into key-value pairs.

methods.name: parseArithmetic
methods.description: Parses an arithmetic formula into a stack for evaluation, ensuring correct operator precedence.

methods.name: tokenizeFormula
methods.description: Tokenizes an arithmetic formula string into operators, numbers, and variables.

methods.name: evaluatePlural
methods.description: Evaluates a plural formula stack for a specific plural value to determine the correct plural form index.
